entities.summary: Francesco Trevisani was an Italian painter, active in the period called either early Rococo or late Baroque (barochetto). He was strongly influenced by Carlo Maratta, as is manifest in his masterpiece, the frescoes in San Silvestro in Capite (1695–1696).
